title: Taiwan urged to pursue affordable AI, as Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit adds uncertainty to AI hardware standards
html: Taiwan's Minister of the National Science and Technology Council Cheng-wen Wu pointed out at a recent press conference on November 16 that the technology rivalry between the US and China is highly complex, with many US strategies contradicting one another...
